task.title: Fix relayfile SDK package version resolution in compiled Bun binaries

raw.question: Bundle package metadata through a JSON import
raw.chosen: Bundle package metadata through a JSON import
raw.reasoning: createRequire('../package.json') resolves relative to Bun's virtual compiled module path and fails; a static JSON import is bundled into the executable while preserving the package manifest version as the release URL source.

retrospective.summary: Replaced runtime createRequire package lookup in @relayfile/sdk workspace-mount with a bundled package.json import, added a compiled Bun regression, and verified baseline failure versus fixed execution.
